content.value: A job is rated in terms of wages of TK 800 per day. The standard time set for the Job is 15 days, 8 hrs / day. Four workers have taken 100,110,120 and 140 hrs respectively for the completion of the job. A bonus of 75% on the time taken will be given only to those who have completed the job in the standard time. Calculate the earning of individuals by Halsey Plan.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2018
